fields.summary_ko.0: Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) saw its stock price plunge to $121 compared to the IPO price of $135 following the midterm elections, but has recovered to near $142; still down 37% from the June high of $225.64.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue reached $14.6B, up 161% year-over-year, with the AI 'superintelligence' business surging from $813M to $7.6B, accounting for over 50% of total revenue.
fields.summary_ko.2: Concern over volatility from insider lockup release on December 8; analysts note waiting for price declines before buying.
